rows.prompt: Summarize in 2–3 sentences: Local language models run on your own hardware, so prompts never leave the machine. They are slower than cloud APIs on modest CPUs, but avoid per-token fees and third-party logging.
Write a Python function `is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool` that ignores spaces and case. Return only the function, no explanation.
What is the capital of France? Answer in one short sentence.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost? Show one line of reasoning, then the answer.
Write a 4-line poem about a laptop that only works offline. No title, just the poem.
Reply with exactly three bullet points, each starting with '- ', listing benefits of running AI models locally. No other text.
Name the planet in our solar system that is known for its prominent rings. One word answer only.
